author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
Thanks to my plumber Marc from Horizon Plumbing in Ottawa for this tip. The video explains how to reduce the time it takes to get hot water from about two minutes down to three seconds. The delay in getting hot water occurs because the system has to push the old cold water out of the way before the hot water can reach the fixture, regardless of whether the water heater is tank or tankless.

The solution is to add a recirculation line.
